examples.en: My wallet is in my pants pocket.
I took my keys out of my pocket.
The coat pockets are deep, so my hands stay warm.
The pocket is so small that my phone doesn't fit.
The child filled his pocket with candy.
Walking with your hands in your pockets is dangerous.

explain: 옷에 달린 주머니도, 작은 물건을 넣는 작은 자루도 모두 '주머니'예요. '주머니에 넣다', '주머니에서 꺼내다'처럼 '에', '에서'와 함께 써요. '주머니 사정'처럼 돈 이야기에도 써요.

phrases.example: 이번 달은 주머니 사정이 안 좋아서 여행은 못 가요.
phrases.en: My finances are tight this month, so I can't go on a trip.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가지고 있는 돈의 형편을 말해요. '주머니가 가볍다'도 돈이 별로 없다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: It describes how much money you have on hand. '주머니가 가볍다' also means you have little money.

explain_en: Both a pocket sewn into clothes and a small pouch for carrying things are '주머니'. It goes with '에' and '에서', as in '주머니에 넣다' and '주머니에서 꺼내다'. It also appears in money talk, as in '주머니 사정'.
